Portronics Muffs M6 Wireless Headphones – Up to 40 Hours Playtime

Experience immersive audio and all-day comfort with the Portronics Muffs M6 Wireless Headphones, designed for music lovers, professionals, and everyday users who demand performance and style. Featuring up to 40 hours playtime, advanced Bluetooth version 5.4, and soft & comfortable ear cushions, these headphones deliver a premium listening experience whether you’re working, traveling, or relaxing at home.

Built with modern users in mind, the Portronics Muffs M6 Wireless Headphones offer seamless connectivity, stable wireless performance, and superior sound clarity. With dual pairing support, you can stay connected to two devices at once, making it easy to switch between calls and entertainment without interruption.

Powerful Battery with Type-C Fast Charging

One of the standout features of the Portronics Muffs M6 is its impressive battery life. Enjoy up to 40 hours of continuous playtime on a single charge, ensuring uninterrupted music, calls, and streaming throughout the day. Thanks to Type-C fast charging, you spend less time charging and more time listening. A quick charge delivers hours of playback, making these wireless headphones ideal for busy lifestyles.

Advanced Bluetooth 5.4 for Seamless Connectivity

Equipped with the latest Bluetooth version 5.4, the provide faster pairing, extended range, and a stable connection with minimal latency. Whether paired with smartphones, laptops, tablets, or smart TVs, the audio remains smooth and uninterrupted, making these headphones perfect for music, movies, online meetings, and gaming.

Soft & Comfortable Ear Cushions for All-Day Use

Comfort meets durability with the soft & comfortable ear cushions of the Muffs M6. The plush padding reduces pressure on your ears, allowing extended listening sessions without fatigue. The adjustable headband ensures a secure and customized fit for all users, making these over-ear suitable for long workdays, travel, or binge-watching sessions.

Dual Pairing for Maximum Convenience

Stay connected effortlessly with dual pairing technology. The let you connect to two devices simultaneously, so you never miss an important call while enjoying your favorite playlist or videos. This feature is especially useful for professionals who switch between work and personal devices throughout the day.

Stylish Design in Black & Beige Colors

Available in elegant Black and Beige color options, the Portronics Muffs M6 blends modern aesthetics with everyday practicality. Its sleek, lightweight design complements both casual and professional looks, making it a stylish accessory as well as a high-performance audio device.

  • Soft & comfortable ear cushions for extended use

  • Premium over-ear design with adjustable headband
